title: Maya’s Last Trip
summary: The investigator opens the cited parking record, establishes that van GKT-482 left the Press Club Garage at 18:40 on 2025-09-18, compares Calder Development’s assignment roster to identify Owen Blake, and follows the record’s Camera matches link to city camera log CAM-0918-221, which places the van at 18 Mason Street at 19:12. The plate alone is submitted to Maya’s police case, producing the handoff to check the property directory.

setting.location: Parking records and the traffic camera log

phases.title: Parking Record
phases.summary: Use the invoice attachment and lookup to establish the vehicle and departure event.

phases.title: Driver and Camera Records
phases.summary: Compare the fleet assignment and follow the camera match for the same vehicle.

phases.title: Police Submission
phases.summary: Submit the corroborated vehicle plate to Maya’s case.

puzzles.title: Press Club Garage Parking Record
puzzles.purpose: Examine the parking record cited by Maya’s invoice to learn which vehicle left the garage at 18:40 and obtain the on-page links needed to compare its assignment and camera matches.

generationSpec.documentTheme: Parking ticket QR beside a machine-readable record table

verification.prompt: What vehicle plate is recorded as leaving the Press Club Garage at 18:40? Enter it in ABC-123 format.

inputs.use: In the invoice evidence package, click “Open parking record,” copy PARK-0918-664 into the Parking reference field on the linked parking lookup, and open the matched record.

outputs.description: Vehicle plate shown in parking record PARK-0918-664 for the 2025-09-18 18:40 exit from Press Club Garage.
The parking result’s visible “Calder vehicle assignments” link opens the owner’s assignment roster for comparison.
The parking result’s visible “Camera matches” link opens city camera records already filtered to the plate and date.

design.revealContext: The matched parking result displays the date, 18:40 exit time, Press Club Garage location, Calder Development ownership, and visible links labeled “Calder vehicle assignments” and “Camera matches.”

record.plateEvidence: A parking-ticket QR decodes to the plate printed beside it.

puzzles.title: Calder Vehicle Assignment
puzzles.purpose: Compare Calder Development’s dated fleet assignments with the parking plate to identify the employee responsible for that van when Maya disappeared.

generationSpec.documentTemplate:
Calder Development — Vehicle assignments for 2025-09-18
JRM-205 — Priya Shah — Site inspection
GKT-482 — {{ANOMALY}} — Equipment pickup
LND-731 — Marcus Reed — Permit delivery
Assignment records are published for dispatch review.
generationSpec.normalityContext: Each fleet row contains a plate, employee name, and work purpose. The parking record identifies which row matters.

verification.prompt: Who was assigned to the matched van on 2025-09-18? Enter the employee’s full name.

inputs.use: On parking record PARK-0918-664, click the visible “Calder vehicle assignments” link to open Calder Development’s roster for 2025-09-18.
Match the plate learned from the parking record to the same plate in Calder Development’s dated assignment roster.

outputs.description: Employee named on Calder Development’s 2025-09-18 assignment row for the van matched to the parking record.

data.title: Vehicle assignments — 2025-09-18
data.note: Compare the parking plate with the roster row.

puzzles.title: City Camera Match
puzzles.purpose: Inspect the city camera record linked from the parking result to corroborate the same van’s later location and reconstruct where it went after leaving the garage.

generationSpec.baselineBody: Automated traffic-camera match for 2025-09-18 at 19:12. Vehicle plate: GKT-482. Camera location withheld while the location review was pending.
generationSpec.currentBody: Automated traffic-camera match for 2025-09-18 at 19:12. Vehicle plate: GKT-482. Camera location: 18 Mason Street. Location review completed.

verification.prompt: What building address does camera record CAM-0918-221 give for the van at 19:12? Enter the street address, not a room or unit.

inputs.use: On parking record PARK-0918-664, click “Camera matches” to open the city camera results filtered to the recorded plate and 2025-09-18; select CAM-0918-221 from the one-result list.
Confirm that CAM-0918-221 displays the same plate as the Press Club Garage record before using its reviewed location.

outputs.description: Building address in the reviewed version of city camera record CAM-0918-221 for the 19:12 match.

data.title: CAM-0918-221

versions.Initial automated record: Plate and 19:12 timestamp; location withheld pending review.
versions.Reviewed record: Same plate and timestamp; the completed review displays a building-level street address.

data.instruction: Compare the two dated record versions.

puzzles.title: Camera Record Case Link
puzzles.purpose: Use the reviewed camera record’s visible police case link to reach the legitimate evidence form and confirm that its requested vehicle identifier is the corroborated parking and camera plate.

generationSpec.visibleBody: The reviewed match is attached to Maya Chen’s missing-person case. Use the “Open police evidence form” link to send the vehicle identifier shown in both records.
generationSpec.altText: Traffic camera image. Case attachment note: Submit vehicle plate.
generationSpec.imageCaption: Reviewed traffic-camera frame associated with this record.

verification.prompt: What short instruction appears in the traffic camera image description? Enter the three words exactly.

inputs.use: After confirming the reviewed building address in CAM-0918-221, remain on that record and inspect the traffic camera image description; then click the visible “Open police evidence form” link.
Carry the plate corroborated by the parking record and CAM-0918-221 into the police form’s Vehicle identifier field.

outputs.description: Image-description note confirming which evidence value the police case form requests.
Corroborated vehicle identifier shown in both PARK-0918-664 and CAM-0918-221, ready for the police evidence form.

design.revealContext: The camera record links to Maya Chen’s police evidence form, whose Vehicle identifier field requests the plate corroborated by the parking and camera records.

preview.title: Camera record case attachment
preview.body: The reviewed camera match is attached to Maya Chen’s missing-person case. A traffic camera image has an accessible description containing a short filing instruction. Below it, “Open police evidence form” is a visible link.

requiredResources.description: Project-hosted invoice bundle with the cited parking attachment, PARK-0918-664 reference, and “Open parking record” control.
Parking reference lookup returning the 2025-09-18 18:40 Press Club Garage exit, owner, vehicle evidence, and assignment and camera links.
Calder Development’s dated vehicle assignment roster with comparable plate, employee, and purpose rows.
City camera result and dated versions of CAM-0918-221, including the plate, 19:12 timestamp, reviewed building address, accessible image description, and police-form link.
River City Police evidence form for Maya Chen’s case with one Vehicle identifier field.

terminalAction.title: Submit Vehicle Evidence

fields.label: Vehicle identifier
fields.hint: Use the plate shown in both the parking record and camera record. Format: ABC-123.

terminalAction.successOutcome: River City Police accept the corroborated vehicle lead, associate Owen Blake and the 19:12 arrival at 18 Mason Street with the trip, and display the next handoff: “Check property directory.”
terminalAction.description: Submit the plate in the Vehicle identifier field. Format: ABC-123.

investigationQuestion: Which vehicle took Maya from the garage, who drove it, and where did it go?
startingSituation: The invoice bundle includes an “Open parking record” control. Open the attached session record, compare its vehicle with Calder’s vehicle assignments, and click “Camera matches.”
playerRole: You are Maya Chen’s trusted friend, reconstructing her last known trip from records attached to her fraud research.
playerCapabilities: Submit a vehicle identifier to Maya’s case.
playerConstraints: Match events by date, time, plate, and location.
Do not claim a unit from a street-level camera match.

startingInputs.description: Project-hosted bundle containing the invoice, cited parking attachment, and parking lookup control.
